media.alt_text: Deer in Nara Park with a temple in the background in Nara, Japan

caption.body:
Nara Park — where the deer bow to you (sometimes). An easy day trip from Kyoto or Osaka, and Kōfuku-ji temple next door has a five-story pagoda worth the walk over.

Nara also has Harushika sake brewery, where you can do GF sake tastings — naturally gluten-free and worth the stop.
